game.title: Dying Light
game.blurb: Open-world zombie survival action game from Techland, published by Warner Bros. Interactive, released 2015-01-27. RAWG average playtime: 22 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story milestones in Harran, all hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Quests, Zones and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Side quests, relief packages, rescuing survivors, Safe Zones, Quarantine Zones, GRE chests, Bolters and the text collectibles.

chapters.title: Challenges and Parkour
chapters.summary: Agility and Power challenges, Parkour Fever, Bozak's challenges, long runs and climbs, and one big jump.

chapters.title: Ranks, Crafting and Trading
chapters.summary: Survivor, Agility and Power levels, crafting and blueprints, lockpicking, selling and special arrows.

chapters.title: Combat and the Night
chapters.summary: Fighting the infected and Rais's men, traps, throwing and shooting, and surviving night pursuits.

chapters.title: Co-op
chapters.summary: Co-op quests and competitions with other players.

chapters.title: The Following
chapters.summary: The Countryside story and driving content named in the achievements: the Faceless, the Following, Bilal's race, the Driver Rank, scarecrows and vehicle kills.

chapters.title: Hellraid
chapters.summary: The Hellraid mode: its rank, arena, skeletons, coins, notes and Nightmare runs.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first search result was "Dying Light: The Following - Enhanced Edition" (id 14348), not the expected entry, so rawgDetail was replaced with "dying-light" (id 42215). RAWG keeps "Dying Light: The Following" and "Dying Light - Hellraid" as separate entries; Steam app 239140 ("Dying Light") holds the achievements for both, so they get their own chapters here. StrategyWiki has no page under "Dying Light" or "Dying Light (2015)". dyinglight.fandom.com answers the API under "Dying Light" with about 99 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 11 of 78 Steam achievements are hidden (there is no ACH_69 in the schema). The first nine (ACH_1 to ACH_9, 34% to 89%) look like story milestones and sit in the main story chapter. ACH_70 "Beginnings are hard" (4.0%) and ACH_79 "Into the lava" (3.1%) are hidden but sit among the Hellraid achievements in the Steam list, so they were put in the Hellraid chapter, a reasoned guess. "Well-read" (collect all 10 notes) also sits in that block and was put there. Three achievements with vague descriptions ("Meet your old friend again", "Make that call", "Win Bilal's race") sit in the block of The Following achievements (ACH_59 to ACH_68), so they were put in that chapter by list position. "Be the last man standing" was put in co-op as a guess. "Bozak's challenges" are not named as an expansion in the data, so they sit with the other challenges.
